purpose: Discoverable Cloud Control Plane resource-contract manifest for cloud-capacity resource types. This records the target per-resource control-plane contract for Cell, CapacityReservation, AutoscalerPolicy, and RebalancePlan without claiming provider-live provisioning or runtime controllers.

authority_refs.summary: cloud-capacity target resource types are Cell, CapacityReservation, AutoscalerPolicy, and RebalancePlan; target-only non-claims remain in force.

Defines the Organization -> Account -> Project -> Region -> Cell -> Resource Group -> Resource hierarchy, ORN shape, durable LRO pipeline, required per-resource fields, nine control-plane facets, and target-only non-claims.

Requires discoverable stable cloud-resource contracts with lifecycle, identity, policy, quota, billing, audit, observability, rollback, and reconciliation facets; states current cloud foundations are metadata-only and capacity management is planning-closed, not provider-live.
Parent plan/spec evidence for this manifest and de-dupe boundary.

dedupe_note: This manifest does not touch or unblock t_15ade88d/t_d29b82ea CAPACITY-001 workload capacity_model gate. Those cards remain authoritative for oya/workflow-engine/manifest.json and marketplace/facade/dev-cli capacity_model validation; this card only records the cloud-capacity resource-contract manifest.
non_claims: No provider quota API, provider capacity purchase, committed-use purchase, spot-market operation, OpenTofu plan/apply, Argo CD sync, Kubernetes API call, Karpenter runtime mutation, cell-rebalancer/controller runtime, live Resource Registry, Operation Ledger persistence, runtime reconciler, measured SLO, DR evidence, production readiness, or hyperscaler maturity is implemented or claimed by this manifest.

Current cloud-capacity Rust code remains domain/kernel invariant and metadata guardrail foundation code. This manifest makes target contracts discoverable; it is not a runtime API, provider adapter, or controller implementation.
